evidence: Single package 'app' with clear separation of concerns: models (domain), schemas (DTOs), database (infrastructure), main (application entry point/controller)
Database layer abstracted via SessionLocal and engine in database.py
Models define ORM entities, schemas define Pydantic models for I/O, indicating data transformation layers
main.py orchestrates HTTP endpoints and depends on database and domain layers
Low directory depth (2) and minimal packages (1) align with simple layered monoliths
High maintainability index (100.0) suggests clean separation and low coupling
risks: Tight coupling between layers may emerge if dependencies are not strictly unidirectional
Lack of explicit ports/adapters boundaries may blur infrastructure vs application concerns over time
Single package may become hard to manage as features scale
